audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..6].side read "Skill" on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Ahri, Ahri, Ahri, Orianna.
audit.why: This matchup genuinely changes hands three times — Orianna owns levels 1-2 on free Command: Attack poke, Ahri owns 4 through first item, and Orianna takes the late back on Command: Shockwave. Flattening it to "Skill" in one layer while the other showed the real swings gave two answers to five rows.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side to Orianna, phases[3..5].side to Ahri, phases[6].side to Orianna, matching win[] exactly; ratings and the why text on the flipped rows brought in line with the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Her early shield was attributed to "Dissonance" in spikes[0] and wants.foe[2].
audit.why: Command: Dissonance (W) is the pulse that leaves a speed-up/slow field — it shields nothing. The shield is Command: Protect (E), a 9-second, 1095-range attach that also grants bonus Armor and Magic Resist. Her lane-2 spike is the E, and telling the reader to wait out a shield on the wrong ability's cooldown is worse than not naming it at all.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Command: Protect and its flat 9-second cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ball-position interaction was gestured at ("track the ball position") but never made actionable, and the range relationship was absent everywhere.
audit.why: Command: Shockwave has a 410 cast radius around the BALL and launches enemies toward the ball — so the threat lives where the ball is, not where Orianna is. Charm reaches 975 and your orb 970, both far outside that radius, which means you can open on her whenever the ball is parked on a distant ally or on a shoved wave. Her Q is only 815 and costs a flat 35 mana against your 55-95.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, whys[1], whys[4] and wants.you[2] with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Orianna was written as "his"/"he"/"him" across the entire full layer.
audit.why: Wrong-gender pronouns on every second field are the tell of text pasted from another matchup, and the reader sees it before they see the advice.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases, dosFull, dontsFull and the matching report entries.

notes: Orianna's shield was named 'Dissonance' — Command: Dissonance is the pulse/field; the shield is Command: Protect (E, flat 9s, also grants Armor and MR). Orianna was male throughout the full layer. The level chart disagreed between layers on five of seven rows and, unusually, the content layer had the more interesting truth: this matchup changes hands three times rather than being flat 'Skill'. The single most useful un-stated fact, now added: Command: Shockwave has a 410 radius centred on the BALL and launches toward the ball, so the danger zone is wherever the ball is parked, not wherever Orianna is standing — and both your orb (970) and charm (975) reach from outside it. Not asserted: whether Charm is cleansable or tenacity-reduced, and whether Command: Protect's shield blocks the true-damage half of the orb return differently from the magic half.
